notes.title: Update 0.22
notes.content:
Update 0.22 is now live. 

[h2]Turbines[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31877757/f52728c2081dca7a77d15879c34c322cd2635d5b.png[/img]
-added turbine Test Run Mode: tweak turbine settings while it's running and see how it affects performance
-added manual compressor stage & turbine pressure ratio setup (Advanced Setup - Simple Setup works like before)
-added Bleed Air resource: turbines can provide bleed air that can be used to start other turbines and more in the future
-increased maximum turbine alternator and hydraulic power
-slightly decreased turbine efficiency (engines made in the previous version may require tuning)
-decreased min and increased max combustor temperature

[h2]Rotors[/h2]
-increased max rotor blade count to 8
-added a rotor blade chord setting
-rotor blades can now break under high G-load and speed
-added vortex ring state, overspeed and load warnings to the in-flight readout
-fixed missing sound on the Tail Rotor
-improved rotor audio looping

[h2]Aerodynamics[/h2]
-increased wing drag just after stall which can make the aircraft yaw and possibly spin
-increased camber effect from leading edge flaps
-decreased ground effect strength
-added wing snap sound effect
-fixed incorrect fuselage center of pressure
-fixed asymmetric vapor effects

[h2]New Parts[/h2]
-added a Ducted Fan

[h2]Game Mechanics[/h2]
-added an Era system which estimates the earliest year your aircraft could have been built (currently implemented for propulsion and fuels)
-added Unit Cost, Part Count and Build Time (time you have spent on making the plane) to the craft Specifications window

[h2]Craft Inputs[/h2]
-fixed some bugs affecting the Switch type input

[h2]Weather and Effects[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31877757/1a48981692525e335b91ad086c4d736739987f9d.png[/img]
-added new weather effects: it gets dark and foggy below thick clouds (requires Advanced Sky, Volumetric Clouds and Fog settings to be enabled)
-improved volumetric cloud performance
-increased vertical wind strength as the air moves over mountains
-added contrails for turbines and ramjets

[h2]Other[/h2]
-top and bottom RCS no longer affect stealth rating
-added hardpoint ejection force parameter
-adjusted ramjet performance
-fixed landing gear root hinge drag problem
-added editor directional light toggle

notes.title: Patch 0.219
notes.content:
[b]New[/b]
-added in-flight Fuel Manager panel (click the bottom left fuel bar to open it) 
-added wind direction, speed, gusts and turbulence override controls (flight menu -> environment)
-added a speaker part
-added an emissive part material
-added a detailed error message display if load, save or import fails
-added a warning message when trying to launch while there are disconnected parts in the scene

[b]Aero changes[/b]
-increased low angle of attack lift generation and lift-to-drag
-stalls now occur at a lower low angle of attack and are more violent
-increased lift from camber

[b]Modding[/b]
-added support for world object mods (import airports, buildings, race tracks etc...)
-added support for direct .obj file import into craft project
-added a start time setting to areas.txt

[b]Fixes[/b]
-made fuel fraction and fuel flow gauges functional again
-fixed autopilot throttle not updating the throttle UI
-fixed incorrect aspect ratio calculation of wing units with functional wing edges

notes.title: Update October 28.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31877757/cef8e88ef3ca6ab3c17cf7ed4d9529f69982394b.png[/img]
[h1]New features / changes[/h1]
- Many parts can now be rescaled (hold down F key in Translation mode while a part is selected)
- Added some simple test missions
- Piston engines now have two-speed superchargers (instead of one) and boost is automatically limited, making engine power output more stable
- Part paint jobs are available again
- Fuel amount of non-procedural parts can be changed
- Wings have a new strength slider that can be used to make the wings lighter at the cost of reduced structural strength
- Added control surface input damper setting
- Flying helicopters should be easier
- Added rotor ground effect and vortex ring state
-  Updated graphics

[h1]Fixed[/h1]
- Wing symmetry breaking on load when a wing was centered using the X key
- Cockpits turning black after launching new planes
- Various small bugs
